events.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_l2
events.label: Demand fills from local L2
events.meaning: Demand data-cache fills satisfied by local L2; L1 refill evidence rather than a retired L1 miss count.

events.name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_cache
events.label: Demand fills from local cache domain
events.meaning: Demand fills from a local CCX cache excluding local L2, or remote CCX with address home on this die; not a pure L3-hit count.

events.name: l2_request_g1.rd_blk_l
events.label: L2 data-read requests incl. prefetch
events.meaning: Data cache reads received by L2, including hardware and software prefetch; not a retired-load miss event.

events.name: ls_l1_d_tlb_miss.all
events.label: L1 DTLB misses or reloads
events.meaning: All L1 data-TLB misses or reloads; translation-control evidence, not necessarily page walks.

placement_note: CPU 4/node 0 matches the saved candidate-sweep pinning_manifest. Compare the explicitly selected candidate64/candidate1024 CSVs inside raw_data/raw_data, not the separate outer CSV generation.
selection_note: Five points around frozen L1 K=8/9 edge; seven points spanning the selected L2-candidate K=8..12 mixed transition and reported inferred_ways=11. All existed in Phase I; no new K extension.
